page_title: MAI 1-0 AUG | Mainz v Augsburg 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+16' That's the end of the match.
90+14' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+12' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
90+11' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 19:10.
90+10' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+9' Substitution. Jae-Sung Lee walks off the pitch and Merveille Papela (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.
90+8' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+7' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+7' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+7' Arne Maier (Augsburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Augsburg will take a corner kick.
90+6' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Arne Maier (Augsburg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iago departs the field of play to be replaced by Sven Michel (Augsburg).
90+5' A precise low pass is received by Ruben Vargas (Augsburg), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
90+4' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

90+3' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Robin Zentner easily makes the save.
90+2' Augsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90' The fourth official shows 12 min. of added time.
89' Arne Maier (Augsburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
88' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Arne Engels is replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
87' The resulting corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
86' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
84' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

84' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Finn Dahmen!
83' Substitution. Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) has come on for Brajan Gruda.
83' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) replacing Karim Onisiwo.
82' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
79' Arne Engels (Augsburg) will take the corner.
77' Substitution. Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) on for Andreas Hanche-Olsen.
75' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Kevin Mbabu will be replaced by Robert Gumny (Augsburg).
74' Substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj makes way for Mads Pedersen (Augsburg).
70' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
70' Anthony Caci (Mainz) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Finn Dahmen was alert and made an astonishing save!
69' The attendance is 26000.
67' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.
64' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes it short.
61' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
61' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
51' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.

49' The corner lands on the head of Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
49' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
46' Jess Thorup makes a switch. Pep Biel (Augsburg) is coming on in place of Phillip Tietz at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
45+5' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Reichel didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+5' The Mainz players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
45+5' Referee Tobias Reichel makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
45+4' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
45+3' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

43' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Nadiem Amiri flights the free kick into the box, where Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) peels off his marker and heads straight inside the upright from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.
43' It seemed like Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
42' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

41' Robin Zentner pulls off a fantastic save! Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
40' The corner from Arne Engels (Augsburg) is hurriedly cleared.

38' OFF THE BAR! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
37' Arne Engels (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
36' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
35' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) for his blatant foul.

33' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
32' Referee Tobias Reichel sees the trip by Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
30' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
28' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
27' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) but poses no threat.
26' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
24' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Finn Dahmen intercepts the ball.

24' Iago (Augsburg) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Robin Zentner pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
22' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
21' Arne Engels (Augsburg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
21' Arne Engels (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
18' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
17' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

14' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.

12' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Finn Dahmen makes a comfortable save.
12' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
12' The ball is behind the sideline. Brajan Gruda (Mainz) takes a throw-in.
9' Arne Engels (Augsburg) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
7' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is penalised for holding. Tobias Reichel signals a set piece.
4' The Mainz players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
2' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) heads on.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
